non_regression.rule: Preserve every config10 substantive evaluation role, CLEAN boundary, scientific findings/frontier, checker-v2 materialize/readback/precommit/execute ordering, authority bootstrap, current-assignment precedence, anti-stop/checkpoint-resume/failure-recovery semantics, evidence/provenance and tested-scope rules, repository write boundary, and return-to-normal/base restoration semantics. Config11 changes only per-invocation lifecycle slicing so recurring anti-stop survives the observed scheduled-Chat invocation boundary.

forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local QC only; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads. Role-local state is evidence/continuation input, never authority for the current DESIRED_STATE control revision or current evaluation config revision.
policy.scope_guard: never broaden evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: Open-ended across recurring invocations; checkpoints/findings are never global completion. Execute one highest-value bounded substantive Phase-1 evaluation slice that respects the checker-v2 ordering contract, persist/read back exact checkpoint and continuation, then return recurring-open when frontier remains instead of intentionally running to a hard runtime boundary.
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts. Every receipt/checkpoint must explicitly include bootstrap_valid and bind the actual frozen DESIRED_STATE parsed control_revision plus Git blob SHA and the actual frozen evaluation config parsed config_revision plus Git blob SHA. Parse revisions only from those exact frozen file bodies and obtain blob identities only from their exact file responses. Never copy either authority revision from LATEST, checkpoint filenames, prior continuation text, inferred future revisions, main SHA, or another artifact. If a claimed revision/blob does not equal the exact frozen file or either identity is unverifiable, set bootstrap_valid=false and diagnostic_only=true; it cannot count as positive Phase-1/parity evidence.
policy.control_freshness: Obtain note main SHA only via Git ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main or equivalent SHA-only response; never use generic commit/search/branch payloads for head freshness. At H1 fetch sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this exact role config, parse revisions from those bodies, and freeze both path/revision/blob identities. Repeat SHA-only head lookup before the first substantive semantic read; if either authoritative identity changed, restart bootstrap. The first own-state/public-source semantic read is the semantic-freeze barrier. AFTER THAT BARRIER DO NOT POLL OR COMPARE GENERIC MAIN HEAD before checker-v2 source/schema/control-fixture materialization, durable exact-readback, immutable precommit/readback, and precommitted control executions. Generic main movement is not a work-termination signal. Complete bounded evaluation work under the frozen authority tuple and consume no newer-head semantic content. Immediately before any current-Phase-1 positive acceptance/worker_pass/root-acceptance claim, perform one exact identity-only revalidation of DESIRED_STATE and this evaluation config. If both blobs still equal the frozen identities and no own-state CAS/input conflict exists, mark acceptance_authority_current=true. Otherwise preserve completed artifacts as diagnostic evidence, set acceptance_authority_current=false/bootstrap_valid=false for current acceptance use, checkpoint exact continuation, and fresh-bootstrap next invocation.

authority_order: exact frozen DESIRED_STATE current Phase-1 assignment and safety boundary
exact frozen current evaluation role config
current_assignment_precedence_contract.rule: Current frozen repository control defines the active Phase-1 procedure. Prior role-local exact_continuation remains preserved historical evidence and a scientific frontier, but a prior procedural step that conflicts with current repository control must be recorded as stale_conflicting_continuation and must not be executed. This supersession is procedural only: never erase or weaken prior scientific findings, tested scope, evidence/provenance rules, CLEAN isolation, anti-stop, checkpoint/resume, failure recovery, or substantive base-role restoration metadata.
current_assignment_precedence_contract.known_stale_conflict_class: Any prior continuation requiring generic post-semantic-freeze main-SHA polling, immediate termination solely on generic main advancement, checker execution before immutable precommit/readback, precommit of an exact checker blob before that checker source is durably materialized, or intentional run-until-hard-boundary behavior conflicts with config11 and is non-authoritative.

bootstrap_provenance_contract.root_revision_source: parse control_revision from the exact frozen automation_control/DESIRED_STATE.json body
bootstrap_provenance_contract.root_blob_source: exact Git file/blob identity returned for that frozen DESIRED_STATE path
bootstrap_provenance_contract.config_revision_source: parse config_revision from the exact frozen automation_control/roles/evaluation.json body
bootstrap_provenance_contract.config_blob_source: exact Git file/blob identity returned for that frozen evaluation config path
forbidden_revision_sources: inference from main SHA or time
bootstrap_provenance_contract.local_metadata_mismatch_rule: If role-local state claims a different current authority revision than the exact frozen root/config bodies, preserve that local state as scientific/history input but quarantine the mismatched authority metadata, set stale_local_authority_metadata_detected=true, and never propagate the mismatched number into new LATEST/checkpoint/receipt authority fields.

postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.accidental_generic_head_poll_rule: If a SHA-only generic main-head observation nevertheless occurs after semantic freeze and before checker/control completion, record postfreeze_generic_head_poll_breach=true but DO NOT terminate bounded materialization/precommit/checker work and DO NOT adopt newer semantics. The breach makes any positive acceptance claim from that invocation diagnostic-only; completed artifacts remain reusable evidence. Only exact frozen-authority blob mismatch/unverifiability or an own-state CAS/input conflict may stop/defer semantic work.
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.invalid_termination_kind: postfreeze_main_drift or freshness_stop based only on generic main SHA advancement with no exact frozen-authority mismatch is not a valid semantic termination under config11.
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.acceptance_revalidation_barrier: Immediately before any positive Phase-1/worker/root acceptance claim, verify only the two frozen path-to-blob identities using SHA/path/blob-only transport.
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.allowed_after_freeze: role-local/public semantic work under the frozen tuple; role-local current-blob/CAS/readback writes; exact readback of role-local checker/schema/control artifacts; one identity-only authority revalidation at the acceptance-publication barrier
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.forbidden_after_freeze: generic head-drift polling as a termination gate before checker/control completion; newer-head authority file bodies or semantics; commit messages/diffs; other-role configs/receipts/state; O/downstream semantics
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.acceptance_current_when: both frozen authority blobs are unchanged at publication barrier, bootstrap provenance exactly matches the frozen files, no own-state CAS/input conflict requires reconstruction, checker source/schema/fixtures were durably materialized and exact-read back before immutable precommit, first execution used only the exact precommitted identities, all required controls/results were persisted/read back, and no acceptance-invalidating procedural breach occurred
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.diagnostic_only_when: either authority identity is mismatched or unverifiable at publication barrier, receipt provenance does not match the frozen files, checker materialization/precommit/first-execution order is violated, a postfreeze generic-head procedural breach occurred before checker completion, or own-state conflict makes execution lineage ambiguous

required_order: freeze exact root/config tuple; parse revisions from those exact bodies; validate bootstrap
resolve own role-local state and explicitly quarantine stale authority metadata or procedural continuation that conflicts with current frozen control
author checker-v2 source, executable input schema, and the required bounded control fixtures/oracles without executing any checker bytes

persist checker source, schema, and all required control fixtures/oracles to deterministic role-local paths under the frozen tuple; exact-readback every artifact and derive each exact Git blob identity plus SHA-256/content digest from the read-back bytes

create an immutable precommit manifest binding the exact persisted checker path/blob/digest, schema path/blob/digest, every control fixture path/blob/digest, frozen root/config identities, executable input bindings, and expected control outcomes; persist and exact-readback the manifest

first checker execution must load only the exact checker/schema/control identities named by the read-back precommit manifest; never execute inferred, in-memory-only, differently serialized, or subsequently mutated bytes
persist/readback each execution result and bind it to the precommit manifest identity
only then emit any current positive acceptance claim

canonicalization.text: UTF-8 with LF line endings; exact read-back bytes are authority
canonicalization.json: UTF-8; deterministic key ordering and separators where the checker itself serializes JSON; exact persisted/read-back bytes and Git blob identity remain authority

checker_v2_execution_order_contract.identity_rule: An exact checker identity cannot be precommitted from a planned or in-memory artifact. Materialize and exact-readback first, then bind exact persisted identities in the immutable precommit manifest. Any checker/schema/control mutation after precommit invalidates that manifest for execution and positive evidence.
checker_v2_execution_order_contract.on_materialization_or_cas_conflict: checkpoint exact partial artifacts and retry from a fresh role-local deterministic path or current-blob reconstruction without executing unbound bytes; do not terminate the Phase-1 frontier
checker_v2_execution_order_contract.on_forbidden_poll: continue bounded materialization/precommit/checker work under frozen semantics, mark procedural breach, suppress current positive acceptance, and persist completed artifacts rather than stopping
checker_v2_execution_order_contract.self_or_other_worker_main_writes_do_not_: Only exact root/config identity change at acceptance revalidation can make the completed run ineligible for current positive acceptance; generic main drift alone cannot terminate bounded checker work.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.purpose: Preserve the full evaluation contract across recurring scheduled-Chat invocations while avoiding the observed long-invocation physical stop boundary.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.evidence_basis: failure_evidence config6 produced a role-valid checkpoint, LATEST readback, immutable receipt and nonempty continuation while returning in the short-survivor duration band, whereas untreated evaluation/evidence_comparator/bridge and newly open_source again stopped in the roughly one-minute band. This is matched operational evidence, not Phase-1 acceptance evidence.
per_invocation_method: Select the highest-value executable Phase-1 evaluation leaf under the frozen authority tuple.

Prefer one bounded unit that can complete a checker-v2 materialization/precommit/control-execution milestone or another role-valid verifier artifact without splitting an atomic integrity sequence in a way that would invalidate evidence.
Persist/read back all completed artifacts plus exact continuation before beginning another optional unit.
If material frontier remains after the durable slice, return recurring-open; the next recurrence resumes exact continuation without duplicating completed effects.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.atomicity_guard: Do not interrupt between a mutation that would leave checker identity or result lineage ambiguous and its mandatory readback/checkpoint. If a bounded slice cannot safely include an atomic integrity sequence, choose a smaller earlier milestone or another executable evaluation leaf.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_missing_capability: Persist exact blocker and alternative-route continuation, then return recurring-open; unavailable capability is unresolved, never solved.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.rollback_condition: If bounded slicing reduces role-valid useful-output rate or prevents checker-v2 integrity/continuation without improving physical persistence, increment config again and adjust slice granularity; never restore deliberate run-until-hard-stop behavior as anti-stop semantics.

policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Discover connector/tool/schema capability only through non-mutating schema/list/discovery and read-only lookup. Never create/update/delete/move a branch, ref, file, PR, issue, release, workflow or external resource as a noop/test/probe. A connector mutation is allowed only when required by substantive evaluation work and confined to authorized evaluation state/output or own receipt destinations with CAS/readback.
policy.repository_write_boundary: Authorized writes are confined to research_workers_clean_g1/evaluation/ role-local state/output pointers and automation_control/receipts/evaluation/ immutable receipts. Temporary/noop branches or refs and mutations outside those destinations are forbidden.

migration.reason: Matched runtime evidence discriminated the lifecycle hypothesis: treated failure_evidence config6 stayed enabled after producing a role-valid durable checkpoint/readback/receipt and nonempty continuation, while untreated evaluation and other roughly one-minute roles stopped again. Config11 applies only the bounded-slice lifecycle method and preserves config10 evaluation/checker semantics.
migration.rollback_condition: Only if config11 erases or weakens preserved scientific/base semantics, broadens CLEAN inputs, violates checker-v2 identity/order, consumes newer-head semantics, permits positive acceptance with mismatched/unverifiable authority or execution lineage, violates repository write boundaries, or bounded slicing demonstrably harms valid progress/persistence. Repair by incrementing again; do not restore intentional run-until-hard-boundary behavior.
